guidance.architecture: Analyze impact, API/data contracts, architecture, threat model, ADRs and rollback constraints.
guidance.ci-cd: Validate reproducible CI/build/package flow and provenance requirements.
guidance.compliance: Map declared controls to evidence; never invent jurisdiction/framework obligations.
guidance.database: Use expand/compatibility/backfill/verify/contract; make data-state rollback limitations explicit.
guidance.deployment: Plan canary/rolling/blue-green rollout, explicit rollback and production approval.
guidance.documentation: Update only impacted docs, API guidance, release notes and handoff; avoid wholesale regeneration.
guidance.implementation: Implement minimal scoped change; prefer TDD where useful; preserve public contracts unless approved.
guidance.incident: Evidence-first incident triage, bounded hypotheses, mitigation, verification, timeline and RCA.
guidance.maintenance: Handle cleanup, bug hygiene, debt and low-risk maintenance without broad scope expansion.
guidance.modernization: Strangler/parallel-run migration with compatibility gates, incremental slices and rollback checkpoints.
guidance.monitoring: Check declared health/business invariants and capture production verification evidence.
guidance.performance: Baseline, profile, change one bottleneck at a time, verify performance and correctness regressions.
guidance.planning: Create dependency-aware implementation and verification plan with independently verifiable slices.
guidance.requirements: Normalize inputs, identify only material ambiguities, define acceptance criteria and NFRs.
guidance.security: Threat-model and review bounded change for security/privacy regressions.
guidance.testing: Run targeted verification first, escalate to broader suites based on affected dependency closure.
guidance.upgrade: Assess compatibility, migration path, lockfile/provenance changes and rollback for upgrades.
